p.src: 1  Preserve me, God, for I take refuge in you.

en: Preserve me, God, for I take refuge in you.
u.src: 1  Preserve me, God, for I take refuge in you.

p.src: 2  My soul, you have said to the LORD, “You are my Lord. Apart from you I have no good thing.”

en: My soul, you have said to the LORD, “You are my Lord. Apart from you I have no good thing.”
u.src: 2  My soul, you have said to the LORD, “You are my Lord. Apart from you I have no good thing.”

p.src: 3  As for the saints who are on the earth, they are the excellent ones in whom is all my delight.

en: As for the saints who are on the earth, they are the excellent ones in whom is all my delight.
u.src: 3  As for the saints who are on the earth, they are the excellent ones in whom is all my delight.

p.src: 4  Their sorrows shall be multiplied who give gifts to another god. Their drink offerings of blood I will not offer, nor take their names on my lips.

en: Their sorrows shall be multiplied who give gifts to another god. Their drink offerings of blood I will not offer, nor take their names on my lips.
u.src: 4  Their sorrows shall be multiplied who give gifts to another god. Their drink offerings of blood I will not offer, nor take their names on my lips.

p.src: 5  The LORD assigned my portion and my cup. You made my lot secure.

en: The LORD assigned my portion and my cup. You made my lot secure.
u.src: 5  The LORD assigned my portion and my cup. You made my lot secure.

p.src: 6  The lines have fallen to me in pleasant places. Yes, I have a good inheritance.

en: The lines have fallen to me in pleasant places. Yes, I have a good inheritance.
u.src: 6  The lines have fallen to me in pleasant places. Yes, I have a good inheritance.

p.src: 7  I will bless the LORD, who has given me counsel. Yes, my heart instructs me in the night seasons.

en: I will bless the LORD, who has given me counsel. Yes, my heart instructs me in the night seasons.
u.src: 7  I will bless the LORD, who has given me counsel. Yes, my heart instructs me in the night seasons.

p.src: 8  I have set the LORD always before me. Because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.

en: I have set the LORD always before me. Because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.
u.src: 8  I have set the LORD always before me. Because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.

p.src: 9  Therefore my heart is glad, and my tongue rejoices. My body shall also dwell in safety.

en: Therefore my heart is glad, and my tongue rejoices. My body shall also dwell in safety.
u.src: 9  Therefore my heart is glad, and my tongue rejoices. My body shall also dwell in safety.

p.src: 10  For you will not leave my soul in Sheol, neither will you allow your holy one to see corruption.

en: For you will not leave my soul in Sheol, neither will you allow your holy one to see corruption.
u.src: 10  For you will not leave my soul in Sheol, neither will you allow your holy one to see corruption.

en: 16:10 Sheol is the place of the dead.

p.src: 11  You will show me the path of life. In your presence is fullness of joy. In your right hand there are pleasures forever more.

en: You will show me the path of life. In your presence is fullness of joy. In your right hand there are pleasures forever more.
u.src: 11  You will show me the path of life. In your presence is fullness of joy. In your right hand there are pleasures forever more.
